select * from d360.STG_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE

select COLUMN_NAME from information_schema.columns where table_name like 'DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE' and table_schema = 'BNKM'




WITH SRC AS (
SELECT TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM,BANK_ID
    from (
SELECT
	 CONVERT(DATE,TRAN_DATE) AS TRAN_DATE
	,TRAN_ID
	,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
	,DEL_FLG
	,TRAN_TYPE
	,TRAN_SUB_TYPE
	,PART_TRAN_TYPE
	,GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE
	,ACID
	,VALUE_DATE
	,isnull(TRAN_AMT,0) AS TRAN_AMT
	,TRAN_PARTICULAR
	,ENTRY_USER_ID
	,PSTD_USER_ID
	,VFD_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(ENTRY_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS ENTRY_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(PSTD_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PSTD_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(VFD_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS VFD_DATE
	,RPT_CODE
	,REF_NUM
	,INSTRMNT_TYPE
    ,CONVERT(DATE,INSTRMNT_DATE) AS INSTRMNT_DATE
	,INSTRMNT_NUM
	,INSTRMNT_ALPHA
	,TRAN_RMKS
	,PSTD_FLG
	,PRNT_ADVC_IND
	,AMT_RESERVATION_IND
	,isnull(RESERVATION_AMT,0) AS RESERVATION_AMT
	,RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,CUST_ID
	,VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG
	,MODULE_ID
	,BR_CODE
	,isnull(FX_TRAN_AMT,0) AS FX_TRAN_AMT
	,RATE_CODE
	,isnull(RATE,0) AS RATE
	,CRNCY_CODE
	,NAVIGATION_FLG
	,TRAN_CRNCY_CODE
	,REF_CRNCY_CODE
	,isnull(REF_AMT,0) AS REF_AMT
	,SOL_ID
	,BANK_CODE
	,TREA_REF_NUM
	,isnull(TREA_RATE,0) AS TREA_RATE
	,TS_CNT
	,GST_UPD_FLG
	,ISO_FLG
	,EABFAB_UPD_FLG
	,LIFT_LIEN_FLG
	,PROXY_POST_IND
	,SI_SRL_NUM
	,CONVERT(DATE,SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE) AS SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE
	,PR_SRL_NUM
	,SERIAL_NUM
	,DEL_MEMO_PAD
	,UAD_MODULE_ID
	,UAD_MODULE_KEY
	,CONVERT(DATE,REVERSAL_DATE) AS REVERSAL_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE) AS REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE
	,PTTM_EVENT_TYPE
	,PROXY_ACID
	,TOD_ENTITY_TYPE
	,TOD_ENTITY_ID
	,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
	,isnull(REGULARIZATION_AMT,0) AS REGULARIZATION_AMT
	,isnull(PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT,0) AS PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT
	,TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID
	,TRAN_PARTICULAR_2
	,TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE
	,TR_STATUS
	,SVS_TRAN_ID
	,CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG
	,REFERRAL_ID
	,PARTY_CODE
	,CONVERT(DATE,GL_DATE) AS GL_DATE
	,BKDT_TRAN_FLG
	,BANK_ID
	,IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG
	,PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG
	,MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG
	,isnull(USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,0) AS USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
	,isnull(USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,0) AS USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
	,isnull(USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT,0) AS USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT
	,isnull(USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN,0) AS USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN
	,isnull(USED_EMER_ADVN,0) AS USED_EMER_ADVN
	,GL_SEGMENT_STRING
	,COMB_TRAN_ID
	,SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE
	,USER_PART_TRAN_CODE
	,TRAN_FREE_CODE1
	,TRAN_FREE_CODE2
	,RESP_ACCT_REF_NO
	,PURPOSE_CODE
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,INSERT_DTTM) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM D360.STG_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE
WHERE H = 'D'
) A ) , TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM,DEL_FLG,TRAN_TYPE,TRAN_SUB_TYPE,PART_TRAN_TYPE,GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE,ACID,VALUE_DATE,TRAN_AMT,TRAN_PARTICULAR,ENTRY_USER_ID,PSTD_USER_ID,VFD_USER_ID,ENTRY_DATE,PSTD_DATE,VFD_DATE,RPT_CODE,REF_NUM,INSTRMNT_TYPE,INSTRMNT_DATE,INSTRMNT_NUM,INSTRMNT_ALPHA,TRAN_RMKS,PSTD_FLG,PRNT_ADVC_IND,AMT_RESERVATION_IND,RESERVATION_AMT,RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,CUST_ID,VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG,MODULE_ID,BR_CODE,FX_TRAN_AMT,RATE_CODE,RATE,CRNCY_CODE,NAVIGATION_FLG,TRAN_CRNCY_CODE,REF_CRNCY_CODE,REF_AMT,SOL_ID,BANK_CODE,TREA_REF_NUM,TREA_RATE,TS_CNT,GST_UPD_FLG,ISO_FLG,EABFAB_UPD_FLG,LIFT_LIEN_FLG,PROXY_POST_IND,SI_SRL_NUM,SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE,PR_SRL_NUM,SERIAL_NUM,DEL_MEMO_PAD,UAD_MODULE_ID,UAD_MODULE_KEY,REVERSAL_DATE,REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE,PTTM_EVENT_TYPE,PROXY_ACID,TOD_ENTITY_TYPE,TOD_ENTITY_ID,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID,REGULARIZATION_AMT,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT,TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID,TRAN_PARTICULAR_2,TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE,TR_STATUS,SVS_TRAN_ID,CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG,REFERRAL_ID,PARTY_CODE,GL_DATE,BKDT_TRAN_FLG,BANK_ID,IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG,PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG,MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN,USED_EMER_ADVN,GL_SEGMENT_STRING,COMB_TRAN_ID,SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE,USER_PART_TRAN_CODE,TRAN_FREE_CODE1,TRAN_FREE_CODE2,RESP_ACCT_REF_NO,PURPOSE_CODE
))	AS HASHROW,TRAN_DATE,TRAN_ID,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM,BANK_ID
FROM	BUSC.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE
WHERE	isLatest = 1 
)SELECT * FROM TGT	;


SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE TGT
WHERE  tran_id = 'SAB752938' AND ISLATEST = 1

UPDATE TGT
SET ISLATEST = 0
FROM BUSC.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE TGT
WHERE  ISLATEST = 1
AND EXISTS (
SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE SRC where  H = 'D'
AND SRC.TRAN_DATE=TGT.TRAN_DATE
AND SRC.TRAN_ID=TGT.TRAN_ID
AND SRC.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM=TGT.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
AND SRC.BANK_ID=TGT.BANK_ID
AND BINARY_CHECKSUM(SRC.TRAN_DATE,SRC.TRAN_ID,SRC.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM,SRC.DEL_FLG,SRC.TRAN_TYPE,SRC.TRAN_SUB_TYPE,SRC.PART_TRAN_TYPE,SRC.GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE,SRC.ACID,SRC.VALUE_DATE,SRC.TRAN_AMT,SRC.TRAN_PARTICULAR,SRC.ENTRY_USER_ID,SRC.PSTD_USER_ID,SRC.VFD_USER_ID,SRC.ENTRY_DATE,SRC.PSTD_DATE,SRC.VFD_DATE,SRC.RPT_CODE,SRC.REF_NUM,SRC.INSTRMNT_TYPE,SRC.INSTRMNT_DATE,SRC.INSTRMNT_NUM,SRC.INSTRMNT_ALPHA,SRC.TRAN_RMKS,SRC.PSTD_FLG,SRC.PRNT_ADVC_IND,SRC.AMT_RESERVATION_IND,SRC.RESERVATION_AMT,SRC.RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND,SRC.LCHG_USER_ID,SRC.LCHG_TIME,SRC.RCRE_USER_ID,SRC.RCRE_TIME,SRC.CUST_ID,SRC.VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG,SRC.MODULE_ID,SRC.BR_CODE,SRC.FX_TRAN_AMT,SRC.RATE_CODE,SRC.RATE,SRC.CRNCY_CODE,SRC.NAVIGATION_FLG,SRC.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE,SRC.REF_CRNCY_CODE,SRC.REF_AMT,SRC.SOL_ID,SRC.BANK_CODE,SRC.TREA_REF_NUM,SRC.TREA_RATE,SRC.TS_CNT,SRC.GST_UPD_FLG,SRC.ISO_FLG,SRC.EABFAB_UPD_FLG,SRC.LIFT_LIEN_FLG,SRC.PROXY_POST_IND,SRC.SI_SRL_NUM,SRC.SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE,SRC.PR_SRL_NUM,SRC.SERIAL_NUM,SRC.DEL_MEMO_PAD,SRC.UAD_MODULE_ID,SRC.UAD_MODULE_KEY,SRC.REVERSAL_DATE,SRC.REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE,SRC.PTTM_EVENT_TYPE,SRC.PROXY_ACID,SRC.TOD_ENTITY_TYPE,SRC.TOD_ENTITY_ID,SRC.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID,SRC.REGULARIZATION_AMT,SRC.PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT,SRC.TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID,SRC.TRAN_PARTICULAR_2,SRC.TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE,SRC.TR_STATUS,SRC.SVS_TRAN_ID,SRC.CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG,SRC.REFERRAL_ID,SRC.PARTY_CODE,SRC.GL_DATE,SRC.BKDT_TRAN_FLG,SRC.BANK_ID,SRC.IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG,SRC.PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG,SRC.MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG,SRC.USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,SRC.USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,SRC.USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT,SRC.USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN,SRC.USED_EMER_ADVN,SRC.GL_SEGMENT_STRING,SRC.COMB_TRAN_ID,SRC.SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE,SRC.USER_PART_TRAN_CODE,SRC.TRAN_FREE_CODE1,SRC.TRAN_FREE_CODE2,SRC.RESP_ACCT_REF_NO,SRC.PURPOSE_CODE)
= BINARY_CHECKSUM(TGT.TRAN_DATE,TGT.TRAN_ID,TGT.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM,TGT.DEL_FLG,TGT.TRAN_TYPE,TGT.TRAN_SUB_TYPE,TGT.PART_TRAN_TYPE,TGT.GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE,TGT.ACID,TGT.VALUE_DATE,TGT.TRAN_AMT,TGT.TRAN_PARTICULAR,TGT.ENTRY_USER_ID,TGT.PSTD_USER_ID,TGT.VFD_USER_ID,TGT.ENTRY_DATE,TGT.PSTD_DATE,TGT.VFD_DATE,TGT.RPT_CODE,TGT.REF_NUM,TGT.INSTRMNT_TYPE,TGT.INSTRMNT_DATE,TGT.INSTRMNT_NUM,TGT.INSTRMNT_ALPHA,TGT.TRAN_RMKS,TGT.PSTD_FLG,TGT.PRNT_ADVC_IND,TGT.AMT_RESERVATION_IND,TGT.RESERVATION_AMT,TGT.RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND,TGT.LCHG_USER_ID,TGT.LCHG_TIME,TGT.RCRE_USER_ID,TGT.RCRE_TIME,TGT.CUST_ID,TGT.VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG,TGT.MODULE_ID,TGT.BR_CODE,TGT.FX_TRAN_AMT,TGT.RATE_CODE,TGT.RATE,TGT.CRNCY_CODE,TGT.NAVIGATION_FLG,TGT.TRAN_CRNCY_CODE,TGT.REF_CRNCY_CODE,TGT.REF_AMT,TGT.SOL_ID,TGT.BANK_CODE,TGT.TREA_REF_NUM,TGT.TREA_RATE,TGT.TS_CNT,TGT.GST_UPD_FLG,TGT.ISO_FLG,TGT.EABFAB_UPD_FLG,TGT.LIFT_LIEN_FLG,TGT.PROXY_POST_IND,TGT.SI_SRL_NUM,TGT.SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE,TGT.PR_SRL_NUM,TGT.SERIAL_NUM,TGT.DEL_MEMO_PAD,TGT.UAD_MODULE_ID,TGT.UAD_MODULE_KEY,TGT.REVERSAL_DATE,TGT.REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE,TGT.PTTM_EVENT_TYPE,TGT.PROXY_ACID,TGT.TOD_ENTITY_TYPE,TGT.TOD_ENTITY_ID,TGT.DTH_INIT_SOL_ID,TGT.REGULARIZATION_AMT,TGT.PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT,TGT.TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID,TGT.TRAN_PARTICULAR_2,TGT.TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE,TGT.TR_STATUS,TGT.SVS_TRAN_ID,TGT.CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG,TGT.REFERRAL_ID,TGT.PARTY_CODE,TGT.GL_DATE,TGT.BKDT_TRAN_FLG,TGT.BANK_ID,TGT.IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG,TGT.PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG,TGT.MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG,TGT.USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,TGT.USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,TGT.USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT,TGT.USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN,TGT.USED_EMER_ADVN,TGT.GL_SEGMENT_STRING,TGT.COMB_TRAN_ID,TGT.SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE,TGT.USER_PART_TRAN_CODE,TGT.TRAN_FREE_CODE1,TGT.TRAN_FREE_CODE2,TGT.RESP_ACCT_REF_NO,TGT.PURPOSE_CODE)
)

/********BU_STGTOBUSC*********/

SELECT
	TRAN_DATE
	,TRAN_ID
	,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM
	,DEL_FLG
	,TRAN_TYPE
	,TRAN_SUB_TYPE
	,PART_TRAN_TYPE
	,GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE
	,ACID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(VALUE_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS VALUE_DATE
	,isnull(TRAN_AMT,0) AS TRAN_AMT
	,TRAN_PARTICULAR
	,ENTRY_USER_ID
	,PSTD_USER_ID
	,VFD_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(ENTRY_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS ENTRY_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(PSTD_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS PSTD_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(VFD_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS VFD_DATE
	,RPT_CODE
	,REF_NUM
	,INSTRMNT_TYPE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(INSTRMNT_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS INSTRMNT_DATE
	,INSTRMNT_NUM
	,INSTRMNT_ALPHA
	,TRAN_RMKS
	,PSTD_FLG
	,PRNT_ADVC_IND
	,AMT_RESERVATION_IND
	,isnull(RESERVATION_AMT,0) AS RESERVATION_AMT
	,RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,CUST_ID
	,VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG
	,MODULE_ID
	,BR_CODE
	,isnull(FX_TRAN_AMT,0) AS FX_TRAN_AMT
	,RATE_CODE
	,isnull(RATE,0) AS RATE
	,CRNCY_CODE
	,NAVIGATION_FLG
	,TRAN_CRNCY_CODE
	,REF_CRNCY_CODE
	,isnull(REF_AMT,0) AS REF_AMT
	,SOL_ID
	,BANK_CODE
	,TREA_REF_NUM
	,isnull(TREA_RATE,0) AS TREA_RATE
	,TS_CNT
	,GST_UPD_FLG
	,ISO_FLG
	,EABFAB_UPD_FLG
	,LIFT_LIEN_FLG
	,PROXY_POST_IND
	,SI_SRL_NUM
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE
	,PR_SRL_NUM
	,SERIAL_NUM
	,DEL_MEMO_PAD
	,UAD_MODULE_ID
	,UAD_MODULE_KEY
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(REVERSAL_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS REVERSAL_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE
	,PTTM_EVENT_TYPE
	,PROXY_ACID
	,TOD_ENTITY_TYPE
	,TOD_ENTITY_ID
	,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID
	,isnull(REGULARIZATION_AMT,0) AS REGULARIZATION_AMT
	,isnull(PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT,0) AS PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT
	,TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID
	,TRAN_PARTICULAR_2
	,TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE
	,TR_STATUS
	,SVS_TRAN_ID
	,CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG
	,REFERRAL_ID
	,PARTY_CODE
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(GL_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS GL_DATE
	,BKDT_TRAN_FLG
	,BANK_ID
	,IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG
	,PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG
	,MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG
	,isnull(USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,0) AS USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
	,isnull(USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM,0) AS USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
	,isnull(USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT,0) AS USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT
	,isnull(USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN,0) AS USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN
	,isnull(USED_EMER_ADVN,0) AS USED_EMER_ADVN
	,GL_SEGMENT_STRING
	,COMB_TRAN_ID
	,SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE
	,USER_PART_TRAN_CODE
	,TRAN_FREE_CODE1
	,TRAN_FREE_CODE2
	,RESP_ACCT_REF_NO
	,PURPOSE_CODE
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM D360.STG_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE
WHERE H = 'D'
